messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from behind. Use the provided camera reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video, then follow the described camera setup and movement. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Please select the version from before the first clothing change was made and apply the following edit to that version: Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: I'd like to change the video's camera setup to a full-body shot from behind. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, and scene unchanged. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The figure stands in the center of an open plaza, turning slightly to the left and then back to face forward.","camera":"A static, low-angle full shot from behind the subject, keeping them centered in the frame.","clothing":"A sleeveless brown patterned top and loose, light beige wide-leg trousers with dark detailing at the ankles.","hair_color":"Platinum blonde.","hairstyle":"Short, swept-back hair with a small bun or twist at the back of the head.","identity":"A slender adult figure, seen from behind, with a narrow waist and bare arms.","scene":"A sunlit, dusty outdoor fairground or amusement park with a striped carousel on the left, a large circular ride on the right, and metal crowd-control barriers lining the area."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output now shows the same character from behind in a full-body, low-angle static shot, centered in the frame, matching the reference framing. The character's clothing, hair, and fairground setting remain consistent, and the subtle body turning motion is preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Change the camera to a full-body shot from behind, matching the reference image's viewing direction, subject placement, and framing, while preserving the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and action timing.
uncertain: Facial expression cannot be verified because the character is shown from behind.
unexpected_changes: The background fairground layout differs from the source, with a carousel on the left and a different circular ride on the right instead of the source's Ferris wheel and pavilion arrangement.
